result.title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
result.comment: Accepted at the 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI 2026). 9 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables
result.summary: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. Frozen calibration-selected policies also beat both always-route and always-defer on held-out test data in 14 of 16 settings in a post-hoc cost-parameter analysis. The strongest prompted configuration reaches 0.477 accuracy on a stratified 1,000-ticket test subset, versus 0.879 for fine-tuned DistilBERT on the same tickets. Isotonic lowers expected calibration error without reliably improving discrimination: GPT-4o-mini few-shot has one confidence value before and after recalibration and correctness AUROC 0.500. We therefore report correctness AUROC and tie-aware risk-coverage area alongside ECE. At the analytically derived break-even probability 0.80, seven prompted configurations defer all tickets; Haiku few-shot routes only 19/1,000. An LLM-only agreement control and margin/entropy rejection baselines further separate calibration from discrimination. The findings are scoped to this dataset, prompt design, model endpoints, and illustrative costs; the work is an evaluation framework, not a new abstention algorithm or universal deployment certification.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 47,837 条 IT 工单八分类任务上评估「代价感知弃权」：在标定集上按显式代价（正确、转人工、误路由）选定并冻结路由阈值，再在测试集一次性评价成本、risk-coverage、正确性 AUROC 与校准误差，对比四种传统分类器与四种 LLM 的零样本/少样本提示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按代价条件选阈值并冻结、以及 break-even 概率与 tie-aware risk-coverage 的评价框架，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益-成本度量提供可供核查的线索；但任务为纯文本分类、不涉及视觉证据或 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。
